newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Police ordered into Colombia's riot-hit jails.
newsitem.headline: Police ordered into Colombia's riot-hit jails.

text.p: Police were ordered to take control of Colombia's top-security prisons on Tuesday after a series of riots and scandals, Justice Minister Carlos Medellin said.

The move comes in a bid to restore security following a week in which 2,000 prisoners, led by convicted leftist guerrillas, rioted and started fires in Bogota's La Modelo jail and an inmate in La Picota, Bogota's other top-security prison, died after accidentally detonating a bomb in his cell.
Earlier this year, at least three provincial jails were rocked by disturbances.
U.S. officials have frequently criticised lax regulations and corruption in Colombian jails.

Colombia's civilian prison guards have previously resisted attempts to replace them with police but have so far not responded to Medellin's announcement which will apply to the country's four top-security prisons in Bogota, Medellin and Cali.
